title: Panta Bhat
description: Panta Bhat is a Bangladesh dish made with white rice, red onion, serrano pepper, lemon. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used. Panta bhat is traditionally rested/fermented overnight; this version uses refrigerated rice soaking to reduce handling risk.

steps.instruction: Spread the rice evenly into the flavorful liquid. Cook uncovered or partly covered for about 22 minutes until the liquid is absorbed; do not over-stir.
Cool the prepared ingredients promptly, then refrigerate for about 60 minutes until properly chilled.
Cover the fully cooked, quickly cooled rice with drinking water and soak refrigerated overnight; discard if poorly stored or off-smelling.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
